materialBoundaries.invariant: Provider JSON cannot grant a seat or connect without authenticated readback.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Valid-shaped counterfeit seatRef or revocation during actual readback await; independent controls reject both.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Existing parseAuthority and authenticated production-read client match identity/seat/admission; unchanged API verifies JWT and current durable binding.

materialBoundaries.invariant: Review/Confirm dispatches the original detached request at most once.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Mutate input/returned state, double confirm, stale version or extra authority fields.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: parseOfficeIntent strict public envelope, copied JSON, current projection/version and attempted/busy guards; actual Core three-family parser tests pass.

materialBoundaries.invariant: UNKNOWN does not replay or fabricate rollback/receipt.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Timeout, malformed response, lost ACK or wrong command ACK.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: One dispatch, deadline/abort, UNKNOWN, original id/key plus server fingerprint for existing read-only FINAL lookup; 31 controller/client tests cover rejection and uncertainty.

materialBoundaries.invariant: Queue FINALIZED is not COMMITTED; completion requires same-command durable FINAL and authorized readback.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Wrong command/key/fingerprint, stale readback or another visible decision result.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Unchanged FINAL parser correlates original references; floor rejects older readback; completion matches cause command/fingerprint/version/event. Actual SQL serializer and classified projector tests pass.

materialBoundaries.invariant: Retirement clears private state/installed DOM and fences late responses.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Country/Office switch in same root while drawer is closed, late 403/ACK, or queued native-close callback after reopen.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Shared lifetime retirement, controller nulling and epoch/liveness checks, replaceChildren on closed render, captured close handler checks open. Four independent controls plus shared privacy tests pass.

materialBoundaries.invariant: The browser does not add economic authority or unsupported families.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Industry request, Finance/Trade sent through this port, or adapter status presented as live login.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Independent unchanged Core DTO enumerates only Captain/CB/Social. Industry remains unsupported; real login and G seat contract remain BLOCKED/PENDING. No cookie/PKCE/cache/credential persistence added.
